revision_from_v1.reason: V1 pooled 12 caches and therefore changed corpus size as well as corpus identity. V2 fixes the training corpus to one original-size cache so only fit seeds vary.

purpose: Estimate fit-only rebuild variance on an original-size fixed corpus, then compare it with the closed original-12 corpus+fit variance on an identical fresh research bank.

fixed_training_corpus.anchor_selection_rule: Lowest member id, fixed independent of diagnostic member ranking.
fixed_training_corpus.reconstruction: Exactly reproduce member-01 final training corpus: ordinary.train; novel unique augmentation.train+holdout excluding ordinary strong keys; canonical unique specialist.train+holdout.
fixed_training_corpus.corpus_size_rule: No pooling with any other member and no data enlargement.
fixed_training_corpus.common_corpus_rule: All eight pilot replicas receive the exact same ordered reconstructed member-01 fullpool and specialist corpora.

fit_design.route: postflop made_category>=TRIPS AND FOLD legal -> specialist; otherwise fullpool

interpretation.collection_corpus_heterogeneity_likely_d: Fixed-corpus K8 broad mean-TV AND broad p95-TV are each at most 70% of original-12 values on the identical fresh research bank.
interpretation.fit_architecture_dominant: Fixed-corpus K8 broad mean-TV AND broad p95-TV are each at least 90% of original-12 values on the identical fresh research bank.

attribution_rule.note: The 70%/90% attribution bands are research heuristics frozen before V2 results; they are not promotion thresholds.

next_branch_rule.collection_corpus_heterogeneity_likely_d: Require a second predeclared fixed-corpus anchor confirmation before designing any shared-corpus candidate.
next_branch_rule.fit_architecture_dominant: Do not scale collection; investigate optimization/model/loss stability before another candidate.
next_branch_rule.mixed: Run a fuller factorial research pilot separating corpus and fit components before candidate construction.

exclusions: No member selection, dropping, or weighting.
No use of K=12 stability-bank states for training.
No pooling or enlargement of the fixed member-01 training corpus.
No claim that this research pilot is a deployable policy.
